node.statement: Fix universal constants C_J,e_J and C_sp,e_sp supplied respectively by lem-hcb4-canonical-gram and lem-hcb4-canonical-closeness, and set e_sp,inv=min{e_J,e_sp,1/[4(C_J+C_sp+1)]} and C_sp,inv=4(C_sp+1). For every H-CB datum with e<=e_sp,inv, every n>=1, and each of the two special ordered corners (P,Q) and (Q,P), the corresponding canonical amplification J_n is bijective and satisfies ||J_n^{-1}||<=4/3.
